title: Date of the photograph and the Club Pond Orchestra name
summary: The tour photo dates to 1936, and the band took the name Club Pond Orchestra from its last stop before leaving.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: They paid plenty money for music now, right? Oh what is the date on that photograph? Did I ask you that when that picture was taken? On this? Mm-hmm. Of your band. Tell you one of, when we made that fly, that is one we left, that was in 36.
No, that's the time we made it. And something else I forgot to tell you. You see the last place we played, they gave the name of that place.

We played at Club Pond in Bad Roach. That was the last place we played before we left. And then they gave the band that name, Lawrence Orchestra was Club Pond Orchestra. That's the way they, we went by that name all the way on that tour. And then they just kept it on after we got back.
